lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, approximately circular clusters of pixels arranged in a semi-regular grid across the lateral flank, showing a spatial distribution where centroids maintain relative equidistance in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a grid-like lattice of anchor nodes across the central flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally along the upper third of the visible flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with highlight on the dorsal edge and shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Statistical distribution of approximately 10-15 high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin's silhouette, primarily concentrated towards the fin's base and posterior edge.
dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes (remoras) located near the ventral and mid-lateral surfaces of the primary subject.
